question: Reconcile published DAF rates with Form 990 fee lines for the 18 sampled tail-CF publishers whose realised rate in b4427b-0405 is a band-median imputation ('none visible' on the 990): read each CF's audited statements (fund-fee note or interfund elimination) to see whether the published 100-175 bps is charged and eliminated, or not charged
